name: Oni pyut ne tolko krov
source:
Life didn't work out for Semyon. Unrequited love and a long, severe illness made him gloomy, untrusting, and unsociable. And only his favorite visual novel, Everlasting Summer, helps him not to hit rock bottom completely.

But one day, he finds out that the camp actually exists! After a long, persistent search, even risking his life, Semyon finally ends up in Sovyonok.
And everything seems great, everything is just as he wanted.
But something is wrong with the camp, wrong with the girl. She... is different, unlike herself.
And it only goes on from there! Oddities and inconsistencies snowball.
Semyon has to figure out what is really happening in the camp and find the true love he has strived for so much.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889824533]Steam[/url]]
